summary: Repository contract: treat project as Ji Mu Yun Phase A/B cloud prototype; keep toolchain, phase service, and user sandbox layers separate with independent snapshot/current/cache/LKG authority. Route reads by task via specified indexes/AGENTS.md; follow nearest AGENTS before edits. Prefer FastCtx MCP inspection/execution; explicitly record fallback if unavailable. Communicate with user in Chinese; code/scripts/tests/comments/logs in English; no emoji. Preserve user changes, avoid destructive operations, ask before protected changes (live metadata/workspaces, runtime/Caddy, auth/token/audit, shared LLM entrypoints, delivery/security/public listener settings, generated evidence rewrites). Use UTF-8 for Chinese writes via Python; never PowerShell text writes for Chinese. APIs backward-compatible by default; schema changes preserve data with migration/recovery; auth/runtime/Hosted route changes require boundary, isolation, recovery, acceptance, and targeted validation. Hosted file-changing recovery consumes eight ordered sources and fails closed on missing; live blockers override history. Shared LLM uses canonical docs, UTF-8 stdin, schema-parsed read-only decisions, executable workspace-write routes with acceptance. Runtime recovery checks local health, canonical live scripts, then proxy; never plain dotnet run. Plans are intent, README is status. Completion requires current machine evidence, targeted tests/smokes, logs under logs/, docs only for public ownership changes, and no secret leakage or unsupported breaks. workflow.md legacy path only on allowlisted triggers; standalone requirements do not create VDD without explicit request. Keep AGENTS 6-8k chars, hard ceiling 10k.
